Players Committee card image of [[Imperial Enforcement (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Deploy on table. You may initiate battles for free. Once per turn, if you just drew a character for destiny, may take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Canceled if your non-Imperial character (or starship) on table. [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialenforcement.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c 12d0bca] (12 December 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
